nodes.name: orchestrator_view_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Regression test suite for the workitem_extras-backed orchestrator read paths (read_orchestrator_state, read_linked_sessions, list_interrupted_work_items, mark_work_items_interrupted), which replaced an older orchestrator_runs SQLite mirror table.

nodes.name: project_fixture
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal Project fixture row used to seed orchestrator read-path tests.

nodes.name: work_item_fixture
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal WorkItem fixture row with orchestrator/session fields for tests.

nodes.name: sample_session
nodes.summary: Builds a sample LinkedSession fixture used across orchestrator read-path tests.

nodes.name: read_orchestrator_state_returns_none_for_unconfigured_item
nodes.summary: Asserts read_orchestrator_state returns Ok(None) for a work item with no orchestrator config yet.

nodes.name: read_orchestrator_state_errors_when_work_item_missing
nodes.summary: Asserts read_orchestrator_state returns an error when the target work item row does not exist.

nodes.name: read_orchestrator_state_round_trips_after_atomic_write
nodes.summary: Verifies orchestrator state written via update_work_item_atomic round-trips through read_orchestrator_state.

nodes.name: read_linked_sessions_round_trips_after_atomic_write
nodes.summary: Verifies linked sessions written via update_work_item_atomic round-trip through read_linked_sessions.

nodes.name: list_interrupted_work_items_picks_up_interrupted_flag
nodes.summary: Asserts list_interrupted_work_items surfaces rows with the interrupted flag set.

nodes.name: list_interrupted_work_items_picks_up_active_phase_fallback
nodes.summary: Asserts list_interrupted_work_items also surfaces rows whose current_phase is coding/review even without the interrupted flag.

nodes.name: mark_work_items_interrupted_flips_only_uninterrupted_rows
nodes.summary: Verifies mark_work_items_interrupted flips only rows not already interrupted and snapshots interrupted_phase.

nodes.name: sync_metadata.rs
nodes.summary: Public read/write surface for sync-side per-field revision watermarks and adapter external-id maps stored in workitem_extras.extras_json, used by the merge resolver without exposing the full ExtrasPayload.
nodes.languageNotes: All writes reuse the same update_work_item_atomic RMW path as user-driven updates, so concurrent sync and user mutations serialize at the SQLite layer instead of racing.

nodes.name: read_sync_metadata
nodes.summary: Reads the SyncMetadata (per-field revision watermarks and per-adapter external-id map) for a work item from workitem_extras.extras_json.

nodes.name: find_by_external_ref
nodes.summary: Looks up a work item by its adapter-scoped external id, used to detect existing rows during pull/import cycles.

nodes.name: apply_remote_merge
nodes.summary: Applies adopted remote field values and new revision watermarks to a work item via the atomic RMW update path.

nodes.name: SyncMetadata
nodes.summary: Per-field revision watermarks and adapter external-id map describing a work item's sync state.

nodes.name: views.rs
nodes.summary: Builds Kanban/Gantt/Calendar view-ready projections (WorkItemsViewData) from the raw work item list in Rust instead of the frontend; status/search filters apply after unfiltered counts are computed so filter badges stay correct.

nodes.name: read_work_items_view_data_scoped
nodes.summary: Reads all enriched work items for a project/org scope and assembles the WorkItemsViewData (counts, kanban/gantt/calendar tasks, grouped-by-status lists).

nodes.name: matches_view_filters
nodes.summary: Checks whether a work item passes both the status and search-query filters.

nodes.name: matches_status_filter
nodes.summary: Matches a work item's status against a KanbanStatus filter value.

nodes.name: matches_search_query
nodes.summary: Case-insensitive substring match of a search query against a work item's title and body.

nodes.name: compute_status_counts
nodes.summary: Computes per-status counts (backlog/planned/in_progress/etc.) over the unfiltered work item list.

nodes.name: group_by_status
nodes.summary: Groups the unfiltered work item list into per-status buckets for the Kanban board.

nodes.name: work_item_to_kanban_status
nodes.summary: Maps a WorkItemStatus onto the Kanban-specific status enum.

nodes.name: to_kanban_task
nodes.summary: Converts an EnrichedWorkItem into a KanbanTask DTO.

nodes.name: work_item_to_gantt_status
nodes.summary: Maps a WorkItemStatus (plus target date) onto the Gantt-specific status enum, flagging overdue items.

nodes.name: to_gantt_task
nodes.summary: Converts an EnrichedWorkItem into a GanttTask DTO.

nodes.name: to_calendar_event
nodes.summary: Converts an EnrichedWorkItem into a CalendarEvent DTO for the calendar view.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the pure-SQLite centralized project & work item store rooted at ~/.orgii/projects/, wiring together the schema, paths, io, sync export, types, commands, and events submodules.

nodes.name: paths.rs
nodes.summary: Path helpers exposing the centralized project store's root directories (projects/, assets/, exports/) under ~/.orgii/projects/.

nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Schema DDL for the centralized SQLite project store: creates and migrates tables for projects, work items, extras, labels, milestones, members, routines, and the sync outbox/conflict/import-progress tables.

nodes.name: init_webhook_secrets_table
nodes.summary: Creates the webhook_secrets table storing per-adapter webhook signing secrets.

nodes.name: init_import_progress_table
nodes.summary: Creates the import_progress table tracking bulk-import cursor state per project/adapter.

nodes.name: init_outbox_conflicts_table
nodes.summary: Creates the outbox_conflicts table used to persist field-level sync conflicts for user review.

nodes.name: init_linear_metadata_cache_table
nodes.summary: Creates the linear_metadata_cache table caching Linear workflow-state/team metadata for the adapter.

nodes.name: init_local_tables
nodes.summary: Creates all local-truth SQLite tables for the project store: project_orgs, projects, workitems, workitem_extras, workitem_labels, labels, milestones, members, routine_definitions, and routine_fires.

nodes.name: ensure_projects_sync_columns
nodes.summary: Adds sync-related columns to the projects table when missing, for backward-compatible migration.

nodes.name: ensure_routine_definitions_durable_columns
nodes.summary: Adds durability-related columns to routine_definitions for older databases.

nodes.name: ensure_routine_fires_durable_columns
nodes.summary: Adds durability-related columns to routine_fires for older databases.

nodes.name: ensure_column
nodes.summary: Generic helper that adds a column to a table only if it does not already exist, backing the schema migration helpers.

nodes.name: init_outbox_table
nodes.summary: Creates the sync outbox table that queues per-entity push/pull operations for the sync worker.

nodes.name: sync_export.rs
nodes.summary: Builds sync-record payloads (project/work-item snapshots plus commit/PR ids) for manual export bundles and the git-folder sync flow.

nodes.name: project_sync_record
nodes.summary: Builds a sync_record payload snapshotting a project's current state for export.

nodes.name: work_item_sync_record
nodes.summary: Builds a sync_record payload snapshotting a work item's current state, including commit/PR ids derived from its work products.

nodes.name: project_with_work_items_sync_records
nodes.summary: Assembles the full list of sync records (project plus its work items) for a single export bundle.

nodes.name: sync_record
nodes.summary: Low-level constructor building a single sync_record entry (schema, entity id, timestamp, payload).

nodes.name: pull_request_id_from_work_product
nodes.summary: Extracts a pull-request id from a work item's PullRequest-type work product, if present.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Wire-format types for project configuration (OrgiiConfig), labels, milestones, and members files shared with the TypeScript frontend.

nodes.name: enriched.rs
nodes.summary: Fully-resolved work item type (EnrichedWorkItem) with person/label/project/milestone references pre-joined, replacing raw ids for direct UI binding.

nodes.name: EnrichedWorkItem
nodes.summary: Work item with assignee/labels/project/milestone resolved to their display objects, plus todos/comments/history/orchestrator/work-product fields, ready for direct UI binding.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the wire-format type definitions (config, enriched, orchestrator, project, routines, views, work_items) for the global project store, shared with the TypeScript frontend.
